Name: DifficultySocializing - Friendship Point Scaling
Author: PokeBenji
Description:
DifficultySocializing allows you to adjust friendship points gained from talking and gifting, it also adds a toggle for friendship decay. 
The default is 100(%) which is the vanilla game behavior. setting it to 10 will give you 10% the default value and setting it 1000 will give to 1000% or 10x the default amount,

[b][u]How to Configure the "Difficulty Socializing" Mod
[/u][/b]
[u]Step 1: Install the Mod[/u][list=1]
[*]Ensure you have SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) installed.
[*]Download and extract the "Difficulty Socializing" mod into your Mods
folder in the Stardew Valley directory.
[u]
[/u][/list][u]Step 2: Access Mod Configuration[/u][list=1]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley and go to the main menu.
[*]Open the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) from the main menu to adjust the mod settings.
[/list]
[u]Step 3: Configure Settings[/u]
[b]Talk Friendship Multiplier:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusts the percentage of friendship points gained from talking to NPCs.
[*][b]Default Value:[/b] 100% (same as the base game, i.e., 1x).
[*][b]Range:[/b] 1% to 1000%.
Setting it to 200% will double (2x) the friendship points gained from talking.[/list]
[b]Gift Friendship Multiplier:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusts the percentage of friendship points gained from gifting NPCs.
[*][b]Default Value:[/b] 100% (same as the base game, i.e., 1x).
[*][b]Range:[/b] 1% to 1000%.
[*]Setting it to 150% will increase the friendship points gained from gifting by 1.5 times (1.5x).
[/list]
[b]Friendship Decay:[/b]
[list]
[*]Enables or disables the decay of friendship points over time.
[*][b]Default Value:[/b] true(vanilla behavior).
[*]Toggle it to false
to disable friendship decay.[u]
[/u][/list][u]Step 4: Save Configuration[/u][list]
[*]After adjusting the settings, save your configuration in the GMCM.
[*]Restart the game if necessary to apply changes.
[/list]
[u]Example Configuration Steps[/u][list=1]
[*][b]Set Talk Friendship Multiplier to 200%:[/b]
[list]
[*]In the GMCM, find "Talk Friendship Multiplier."
[*]Enter 200
to set it to 200% (2x).[/list]
[*][b]Set Gift Friendship Multiplier to 150%:[/b]
[list]
[*]In the GMCM, find "Gift Friendship Multiplier."
[*]Enter 150
to set it to 150% (1.5x).[/list]
[*][b]Enable Friendship Decay:[/b]
[list]
[*]In the GMCM, find "Friendship Decay."
[*]Toggle it to true
to enable friendship decay.[/list]

[/list]
